64 WPMS No.1237 of 2025
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Saurabh Kushawaha and Mr. 
Tarun Kumar, Advocates for the petitioner.
Mr. Siddhartha Sah, Advocate for the 
respondent no.2.
After arguing for a while, learned 
counsel for the petitioner restricts his 
prayer to prayer no.5 alone. He submits 
that he does not press prayer nos. 1, 2, 3, 
4, 6, 7 and 8.
In view of what is stated by learned 
counsel for the petitioner, the writ petition 
qua prayer nos. 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7 and 8 is 
dismissed as not pressed.
The petition shall continue qua prayer 
no.5.
Mr. Siddhartha Sah, Advocate takes 
notices for the respondent no.2.
Issue notices to the respondent no.1, 
returnable within six weeks. 
Steps to be taken within a week. 
Respondents may file counter affidavit 
within eight weeks. 
Two weeks, thereafter, rejoinder 
affidavit, if any, may be filed. 
List thereafter, for final hearing. 
 (Ravindra Maithani J.) 
 16.05.2025
RV
